ui.label: Router WAN IP
ui.help: How the router WAN gets its address: from the sender PC like an ISP (default) or set on the router.
ui.available: Turn the sender's ISP role on with 'zeroloss devices wan' in this build

ui.label: Receiver PC network
ui.help: Does the receiver PC get the video over its cable or its Wi-Fi?

ui.label: On device lost
ui.help: What to do when a device stops answering.
ui.available: Stop all + report in this build

ui.label: Recover wait
ui.help: How long to wait for a device to come back.

ui.label: Heartbeat suspect / lost
ui.help: Seconds without an answer before a device is suspect / lost. Default 3 s / 10 s.
ui.available: Fixed at 3 s / 10 s in this build

S-56.value: Keep running to the planned end
S-56.doc: Keep running to the planned end

ui.label: Without the Controller
choices: Keep running to the planned end
ui.help: When the Controller PC stops answering (asleep, network down), the PCs in the test go on sending and measuring until the planned end, and the Controller takes the test up again when it is back. Or they stop after 10 s, as before.

ui.label: Report location
ui.help: Folder for reports on the Controller PC.
ui.available: Set when the Controller is installed in this build

ui.label: Results web access
ui.help: Who may open the results web page.

ui.label: Request signing (pairing key)
ui.help: Sign every request with a pairing key.

ui.label: Tool update check
ui.help: How often to look for new tool versions.

ui.label: Test Wi-Fi (SSID · security · password)
ui.help: The router Wi-Fi tablets and Wi-Fi PCs join by themselves.
ui.available: Set with 'zeroloss wifi set' in this build

ui.label: Problem sound
ui.help: Play a short sound when a new problem appears.

ui.label: Always on top
ui.help: Keep the Agent Desktop status window above other windows on this PC.

ui.label: Test network
ui.help: Baseline: the sender and receivers on one switch without the router, to prove a receiver and its player lose nothing. Each report then shows the receiver's last baseline.
